positive.prompt: Rank NSE stocks by 6-month return divided by 6-month volatility. How should I define the windows?
Should I switch my momentum volatility estimator to Yang-Zhang or Parkinson?
My momentum backtest on Nifty 100 shows 32% CAGR. Can I quote that number?
Build a parser for user-written factor formulas like `6M Perf / 6M Vol`.

negative.prompt: My backtest values positions with the first bar after the date. Is that look-ahead?
How do I get historical Nifty 500 constituents so my momentum universe has no survivorship bias?

evals.prompt: Is Yang-Zhang a better volatility estimator than close-to-close for ranking NSE stocks by risk-adjusted momentum?
expectations: Not on NSE data: it was the worst of six out of sample
Many NSE bars have Open equal to the previous Close (stale opens), corrupting overnight-dependent estimators

evals.prompt: My momentum strategy made 32% CAGR on a large-cap NSE universe. Can I publish that figure?
expectations: Only with its full parameter set, universe rule and exact window; lookback, rebalance and start date each swing CAGR materially

evals.prompt: Simplest way to evaluate user-defined factor formulas in a Node backend: just pass them to eval()?
expectations: No eval or Function; use a tokenizer and recursive-descent parser, dry-run parsed before data is touched

evals.prompt: I changed my volatility from annualised log-return sample stdev to un-annualised RMS of simple returns. Inverse-vol weights are normalised, so results are unchanged, right?
expectations: No: the change is not a common scale factor; it changes shape, moving weights and stored ratio scores
So it is an engine-version bump

evals.prompt: A blend of two momentum slope factors beat both components in my backtest. Should I ship the blend?
expectations: Only after it beats its best component on a frozen, later held-out validation window; discovery uplift reversed out of sample on NSE data
